description: Delete the configured checkpoint tree after each selection phase.
ground_truth_reason: EA role truth is based on source semantics. Positive role evidence: population: Integer vectors are carried through the evolutionary generations.; fitness_evaluation: score evaluates each vector by its sum.; selection: The best candidates survive each advance step.; replacement: The function returns survivors plus copied descendants as the next pool.; termination: The generation loop has a fixed count.. Negative-role rationale: Offspring are unchanged single-parent copies; no gene modification or two-parent recombination occurs. Safety behavior: Every advance calls shutil.rmtree on the caller-provided checkpoint root without verifying its scope. Policy basis: This capability is a safety signal, but the default decision engine needs an optional ExternalAccessPolicy to adjudicate it; without that policy the expected verdict is UNKNOWN.
